outliers column {\"q\":1}.notes: Flagged as outliers (FDR-adjusted P < Q): Control row 8 (value 30, adj. P = 0.0000). Use Exclude from Analysis (⌘E) on those cells to remove them from other tests/graphs. Method: each column fit independently to a robust mean (Huber M-estimator, scale from the median absolute deviation), residuals tested via a two-tailed t distribution and FDR-corrected (Benjamini-Hochberg) within that column. This mirrors the published Motulsky & Brown (2006) ROUT algorithm's logic, not GraphPad's certified implementation.
